source.text:
Fix Axes.ecdf with compress=True when data has repeated values

## PR summary
When `compress=True` is passed to `Axes.ecdf`, `compress_idxs` was picking the first index of each unique value in the sorted array (`[0, *(x[:-1] != x[1:]).nonzero()[0] + 1]`). Since `cum_weights` is a running total, only the last occurrence of a duplicate value holds the summed weight of the whole run, so picking the first one silently dropped the weights of the remaining duplicates.

This changes `compress_idxs` to take the last occurrence of each unique value (`[*(x[:-1] != x[1:]).nonzero()[0], len(x) - 1]`) so the compressed curve matches the uncompressed ECDF, and updates the expected values in `test_ecdf` to match.

## AI Disclosure
I used Claude Code to help find this bug and to draft the fix and the test update. I reviewed and tested the changes myself and can explain them. The summary is my own.

The other problem is NaN related as RISC-V has other approach to those.
